resources.name: Supporting Information for DOI 10.1021/acsami.9b16065 (Tables S1 and S2)

access.notes: Contains Table S1 (initial feature list) and Table S2 (134 compositions with experimental T50 values).

Properties such as atomic number, atomic weight, Mendeleev number, covalent radius, electron affinity, electronegativity, etc., obtainable via the mendeleev Python package or similar public periodic table databases.
Python machine learning library, required for SVR, RFE, preprocessing, and model selection.
